body:
## Summary
- **Ctrl+click** mixer Aux send toggles mute via `Send::deactivate` / `activate`.
- Dim send fill + **Sm** badge when muted; snap `track_send_muted[]`.
- Dummy `--smoke-send-mute` asserts mute↔unmute round-trip (leave unmuted).
- Ctrl+click avoids Alt+click clash with send-reset-all tip #38.

## Smoke
```
win_ardour\run-engine-shell-release.bat --backend Dummy --smoke-send-mute --timeout 25 --no-splash
```
exit 0.

## Policy
Modern D2D + thin Cairo; no gtkmm2; WASAPI shared. Independent of #76–#79.
title: Toggle aux send mute via Processor activate
